import json

API_KEY = '[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]'
URL = 'https://usegalaxy.org'

# Copy the seed history
seed_hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b53102fc1cc4452358'
new_hist = gi.histories.copy_history(seed_hist_id, name='Analysis: ENO1 tumor vs normal proteomics')
new_hist_id = new_hist['id']
print(f"New history ID: {new_hist_id}")

# Download the proteomics dataset
hist_contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_hist_id, contents=True)
print("\nHistory contents:")
for item in hist_contents:
    print(f"  {item['id']} - {item.get('name', 'unnamed')} - {item.get('state', 'unknown')}")

# Find the proteomics dataset
for item in hist_contents:
    if 'Proteomic' in item.get('name', ''):
        # Wait for it to be ready
        import time
        max_wait = 60
        for _ in range(max_wait):
            ds = gi.datasets.show_dataset(item['id'])
            if ds['state'] == 'ok':
                break
            time.sleep(1)
        
        # Download it
        gi.datasets.download_dataset(item['id'], file_path='/workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data.xlsx', use_default_filename=False)
        print(f"\nDownloaded: {item['name']} to /workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data.xlsx")
        break
